'''Fourteen North''' was a ghost [[City/Legends|city]] on [[Polneye]] which was cannibalized for its structures and equipment. It was destroyed through [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|orbital bombardment]] by [[Yevetha]] using the [[Black Fleet]].
